Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly estimated the temperature rise for a "sunny, mild" day. A rise of only ~10°F from 41°F to ~51°F is unrealistic for a sunny day; typically, afternoon temperatures are 15-25°F higher. Furthermore, the Planner's logic for selecting option B (41°F) because it is "closest" to the flawed estimate (~51°F) ignores that 78°F is the only option reflecting a realistic warm afternoon, whereas 41°F implies no temperature change, which contradicts the "sunny" forecast. The error stems from a fundamental failure in domain knowledge (meteorology) during the initial analysis step.
